title: Update tvb_find_line_end use in several dissectors
description:
Use tvb_find_line_end_remaining. Change to unsigned offsets and
lengths.

Note that some of these dissectors had the "false" parameter
that never returned -1, but returned the captured length remaining,
but still tested for -1 anyway. The test was removed, to maintain
the dissector behavior of displaying the last line even if it lacked
a terminator, e.g. with text media.

The SSH dissector did a lot of work to recreate what tvb_find_line_end
did, so just use tvb_find_line_end.

AI-Assisted: no
